verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean states the same balance over a real inner-product space and with the pressure coefficient as a real scalar: pressure_cancellation is t′ + 𝒦t + δ·t − (pressureCoefficient)·n = −f with t′ := projectedRhs, i.e. (7.5) with ikmπ_m n_Φ replaced by c·n_Φ for the real c that makes the residual normal. Recovery: 𝒦, d and n_Φ are real, so a ℂ³ solution of (7.5) is a pair of real solutions of the Lean identity, and ikmπ_m is the one complex scalar whose real and imaginary parts are the two real pressureCoefficients; complex_pressure_sign is where the i·k·m factor and its sign are checked. Two further encodings: (i) 𝒦 is an abstract vector `Kt` in TangentProjection and is instantiated as MovingFrameODE.baseAction only in ambientSolution_hasDerivAt, which is the statement that the constructed amplitude satisfies the equation; (ii) m²d is assembled as damping j z = j²·viscosity z with viscosity = viscosityScale·‖n‖² and viscosityScale = ε·k² (FamilyData.viscosity), rather than as one displayed formula — the literal ε k² j² ⟪n,n⟫ appears only inside viscous_coefficient_nonneg.
